programme.title: Shark Men

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Heartland Shellebration: Dr Ben examines award-winning cows, repairs a turtle's busted shell and aids a young calf with an extra appendage. 7+ (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Forest Babies: Journey into Australia's forests as koalas, cassowaries, tree kangaroos and more take their first steps through a wild and wondrous world. 7+ (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Young and Wild: Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food and an adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Blood in the Water: The team investigates a string of shark attacks on the east coast of Australia, putting local theories to the test and revealing fascinating biology. 12+. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Hazards: Lightning has struck an incoming flight. As engineers assess the damage, high winds lead to runway closures and another plane starts leaking a potentially dangerous liquid. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Porcupine Posse: Dr Oakley checks up on Bindi's pups to get them ready for adoption. Plus there's a problem infesting the reindeer at the AWCC. (S7, ep 10)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Hungry, Hungry Dragons: A rescued panther demands veterinary staff attention. Meanwhile, a pair of 'hangry' Komodo dragons come for dinner! 7+ (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Crocodile: Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: Australia's "boss crocs" faced near extinction from hunting and development, but these dominant predators continue to thrive today. 7+

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Croc v Hippo: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos, while a honey badger fights against leopards and wild dogs cause chaos. 12+. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Dinosaur Island: On the Isle of Wight, researchers have found the remains of an unknown species of dinosaur. This finding could change what is known about prehistoric life. (1 of 10) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Deadline Danger: When arctic storms kick off the coldest winter in a decade, Thord, Bjoern and Jo Roger dice with death in order to keep the ice roads open. (S6, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Rebellion: The forest residents turn on orphaned leopard Motsidi. Meanwhile, the hyenas cause havoc. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Mamba Mayhem: Simon and Siouxsie try to secure a black mamba escape artist, wrangle an irate python, and catch a cat killer. (S7, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Pol Speed Ahead: Dr Pol shines on the track as much as in surgery, trading his coveralls for a jumpsuit and helmet in a real race car. (S3, ep 14)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Chicken of the Sea: Join Dr Oakley as she treats a chunky chicken, a calf that was attacked by a bear and a rescued kitten with worms. (S8, ep 19) 7+

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: A Story of Survival: On the brink of winter, Alaska Natives pursue moose, fish and warmth. 7+. (S3, ep 20)

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Flock Star: It's a roller coaster ride at the zoo. A beloved flamingo fights for his life, a cheetah gets a critical biopsy and the keepers scramble to keep up. (S5, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Psycho Mamba: Simon and Siouxsie chase a frighteningly-fast black mamba that has got into a kitchen. Simon is forced to face his fear of heights to get a snake out of a tree. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River

programme.title: Shark Men

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: What's All The Pus About?: Emotions run high when the Schroeder family races their beloved dog to the clinic with an emergency. 7+ (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: From tree-climbing leopards to skull-crushing jaguars and fast-digging sand cats, find out what makes cats one of the deadliest animal families on the planet.

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Making Waves: The team investigates an attack on a foil boarder in Australia - are sharks attracted to these boards? And does something stimulate an attack? 12+. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Dawn to Curfew: A duty manager encounters a suspicious package, a rookie handles two medical emergencies in one hour and a freight handling crew struggle with a bulging cargo pod. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa

programme.title: Wild Life: Resurrection Island

programme.title: Wild Life: The Big Freeze

programme.title: Mysterious Islands

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.title: Savage Kingdom

programme.title: Snakes In The City

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Duck Duck Chicken: Dr Oakley has her hands full as she balances castrating muskoxen, soothing a duck's sore foot and solving a Labrador's labour troubles. (S8, ep 20)

programme.title: Snakes In The City

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River

programme.title: Shark Men

programme.title: Heartland Docs

programme.title: Untamed Americas
